def solve(case):
    # extract
    payload = case.get('payload', case)  # case may be dict with 'payload' key
    round_scores = payload['round_scores']
    round_targets = payload['round_targets']
    forced = payload['forced']
    # validation
    if not round_scores or not round_targets:
        raise ValueError("Empty round_scores or round_targets")
    num_rounds = len(round_scores)
    if len(round_targets) != num_rounds:
        raise ValueError("Mismatch between round_scores and round_targets lengths")
    N = len(round_scores[0])
    for scores in round_scores:
        if len(scores) != N:
            raise ValueError("Inconsistent score lengths")
    for idx in forced:
        if idx < 0 or idx >= N:
            raise ValueError(f"Forced index {idx} out of range")
    if len(set(forced)) != len(forced):
        raise ValueError("Duplicate forced indices")
    # active as boolean list
    active = [True] * N
    masks = []
    for i in range(num_rounds):
        # get active indices
        active_indices = [j for j in range(N) if active[j]]
        # check forced are all active
        for f in forced:
            if not active[f]:
                raise ValueError(f"Forced index {f} not active in round {i}")
        target = round_targets[i]
        if target < len(forced):
            raise ValueError(f"Round {i} target {target} less than forced count {len(forced)}")
        if target > len(active_indices):
            raise ValueError(f"Round {i} target {target} exceeds active count {len(active_indices)}")
        # forced will be kept
        keep = set(forced)
        needed = target - len(forced)
        # candidates: active indices not in forced
        candidates = [j for j in active_indices if j not in keep]
        # sort by descending score, tie break by index ascending
        scores_i = round_scores[i]
        candidates.sort(key=lambda j: (-scores_i[j], j))
        # select top needed
        selected = candidates[:needed]
        keep.update(selected)
        # new active mask
        new_active = [False] * N
        for j in keep:
            new_active[j] = True
        masks.append(new_active)
        active = new_active
    # final indices
    final_indices = sorted([j for j in range(N) if active[j]])
    return {
        "masks": masks,
        "final_indices": final_indices
    }
